notes.title: Post-PAX Update – Join Our Discord!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We’re back from an absolutely incredible weekend at PAX Aus and we just wanted to say a huge thank you to everyone who stopped by the Mist Forge booth! Meeting so many of you in person, chatting about the game, and hearing your excitement was truly amazing. It's the best part of what we do, and we're so grateful for all the love and support.

Now that we’ve had a week to recover, we’re eager to keep the momentum going. If you want to stay in the loop and be part of the community as Mist Forge continues to take shape, we’d love to have you over in our Discord!

Join the official Mist Forge Discord

We’re sharing development updates, sneak peeks, and all kinds of cool stuff as we continue building the world of Mist Forge. Plus, it’s a great place to chat with other players and be part of shaping the game as it grows.

Once again, thank you all for your support, and we can’t wait to see you in Discord!

Cheers,
The LunarCorp Team
